program.title: BEng in Energy and Environmental Engineering
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-6, 3-4, 1-4).

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. COMP block, MATH block, PHYS block, ENEG 4920/4930/4940, CENG 4720/CIVL 4430), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.

Remarks in the PDF note that the ENEG 3910 course title will change to 'Energy and Environmental Engineering Laboratory' and its credit value to 4 starting from Fall 2027-28 (marked ** in the PDF), and that CENG 4160, COMP 1022P and MECH 4902 were last offered in earlier years and subsequently deleted; they are kept in the lists as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 EEEN (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
